purpose: Sector/industry/identity + listing metadata for ticker->sector mapping.
point_in_time_notes: Current-as-of snapshot (no history) - NOT point-in-time membership; use only for caveated static sector mapping.

purpose: Quarterly income statement (revenue, margins, EPS) for value/quality/growth.
point_in_time_notes: Use fillingDate/acceptedDate (filing availability), NEVER the fiscal period 'date'; as-of join latest filing on/before scoring date.

purpose: Quarterly balance sheet (assets, debt, equity) for leverage/quality.
point_in_time_notes: Use fillingDate/acceptedDate (filing availability), never fiscal period 'date'; as-of join.

purpose: Quarterly cash-flow (FCF, capex, accruals proxy) for quality.
point_in_time_notes: Use fillingDate/acceptedDate; never fiscal period 'date'; as-of join.

purpose: Derived per-share/valuation metrics (PE, PB, ROIC, FCF yield).
point_in_time_notes: Period 'date' only (no filing date on this endpoint) - must be lagged to the corresponding statement filing availability before joining.

purpose: Quarterly financial ratios (margins, turnover, liquidity, leverage).
point_in_time_notes: Period 'date' only - lag to the statement filing availability before joining (same caveat as key_metrics).

purpose: Per-ticker historical earnings dates + estimate/actual EPS & revenue.
point_in_time_notes: Announcement 'date' is the availability date; as-of join the latest announced event on/before the scoring date. STABLE ENDPOINT NAME (/stable/earnings) not yet confirmed live on this plan.

purpose: Actual vs estimate EPS surprises per reporting date.
point_in_time_notes: Reporting 'date' is availability; as-of join; flag restatements. In the stable API surprises appear to be folded into /stable/earnings (actual vs estimated EPS) - endpoint shape NOT yet confirmed live.

purpose: Forward consensus estimates (revenue/EPS) - basis for revision breadth.
point_in_time_notes: Snapshot consensus per 'date'; true revision PIT needs successive snapshots (capture publication date; do not back-date a current consensus onto past scoring dates). STABLE NAME/period not yet confirmed live.

purpose: Analyst buy/hold/sell consensus grades over time.
point_in_time_notes: Each grade carries its 'date'; as-of join the latest grade on/before the scoring date. Stable equivalent (/stable/grades or /stable/grades-consensus) NOT yet confirmed live.

purpose: Analyst price-target changes (target vs price; revision direction).
point_in_time_notes: publishedDate is the availability timestamp; as-of join; never back-date a later target onto an earlier scoring date. Stable equivalent (/stable/price-target-summary or -news) NOT yet confirmed live.

purpose: Current S&P 500 membership (and, via historical endpoint, add/drop history).
point_in_time_notes: Current list is NOT point-in-time; the companion historical constituents endpoint (add/drop dates) is what removes survivorship - collect that to build PIT membership.
